description: On desktop, the app's own page may ask for its workspace's background engine with engine_open, which starts it or connects the window to the one running (B1 step 5, HAL-14220), and call that engine through the engine_* commands: the shell makes each call, so the engine's launch token stays in the shell (B1 step 4, HAL-14219). The page names a route of the shell's table and sends its params apart, never a URL, and ends a call it no longer waits for. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no engine.
